English transcendental differs philosophically from transcendent. Example uses transcendent, matching Armenian and Russian трансцендентный; dictionary untouched.
English deciduous is narrower than Armenian leafy and Russian лиственный. Example describes leafy trees shading a road, compatible with the intended context.
